facts.text: Driver_VISA is the pyvisa connection class: it opens the VISA resource named by address, stores it in self.controller and sets the controller timeout to 3000 ms
The driver forces the SCPI language, selects spectrum mode and sets the ASCII trace format, then builds the Frequency module
get_id queries *IDN? and returns the answer
get_power_marker queries CALC:MARK<n>:Y? as a float; get_power_marker_1, _2 and _3 select marker 1, 2 and 3
The driver model publishes power1, power2 and power3 in dBm
get_timeout and set_timeout read and write the pyvisa controller timeout
The driver model publishes timeout in seconds
get_frequency_start queries FREQ:STARt? and returns GHz (multiplied by 1e-9); set_frequency_start writes FREQ:STAR <value>GHZ
get_frequency_stop queries FREQ:STOP? and returns GHz; set_frequency_stop writes FREQ:STOP <value>GHZ
get_frequency_step queries FREQ:CENT:STEP? and set_frequency_step writes the bare value without a unit suffix or conversion
The driver model declares step with unit Hz and its help text says GHz, so the raw query value is published as Hz
get_frequency_span queries FREQ:SPAN? and returns GHz; set_frequency_span writes FREQ:SPAN <value>GHZ
get_frequency_center queries FREQ:CENT? and returns GHz; set_frequency_center writes FREQ:CENT <value>GHZ and then waits for *OPC?
get_points queries :SENS:SWEep:POINts? and set_points writes SENS:SWEep:POINts with a whole number
The driver model declares points as an int
repeat_sweep writes INIT:CONT ON; single_sweep writes INIT:CONT OFF, then INIT:MODE:SING and *OPC?
The trace is built from frequency_array (start, stop and points) and power_array (TRAC? TRAC1) as a DataFrame with frequency(GHz) and power columns

operator_required.name: frequency_start
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states the frequency range of an MS2830A: the class exposes the sweep window in GHz but gives no band, and the manuals under anritsu_MS2830A/ are PDFs; the site states the range of its analyser

operator_required.name: frequency_step
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states a range for the center-frequency step: the setter writes the bare value in the instrument's default unit (anritsu_MS2830A/anritsu_MS2830A.py:182-187); the site states the step range it uses

operator_required.name: sweep_points
operator_required.reason: no line of the clone states a sweep-point range or a default for the analyser: the model only declares the count as an int (anritsu_MS2830A/anritsu_MS2830A.py:238-240); the site states the count its sweeps need

operator_required.name: timeout
operator_required.reason: the 3000 ms timeout in Driver_VISA.__init__ is the pyvisa controller default, not a bound of the analyser (anritsu_MS2830A/anritsu_MS2830A.py:144); the site states the timeout its measurements need

safe_state.description: repeating sweep off (INIT:CONT OFF): the analyser takes no new automatic sweep
